نتكهرب (form IIq)
# نَتَكَهْرَبُ (natakahrabu) /na.ta.kah.ra.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# نَتَكَهْرَبَ (natakahraba) /na.ta.kah.ra.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
# نَتَكَهْرَبْ (natakahrab) /na.ta.kah.rab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَهْرَبَ (takahraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
